answer: A payout is split and as a result 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The terrace schedule is applied in atlas and kernel shows each instalment. An hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4808 identities would post 4544 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
